papers.title: When Quantization Breaks Memory: Recurrent-State Write-Back in Low-Precision Temporal Inference
papers.what: Freezes a trained GRU and changes only the rule used to store its hidden state, and 4-bit state storage raises estimation error on two fluorescence lifetime parameters by roughly 70x and 300x, because repeated updates fall below the write threshold and the state silently stops integrating; error feedback, residual memory and direction memory recover accuracy with no retraining, and more state precision can make a fixed solution worse.
papers.builds_on: HARMamba (Li 2024, HE9X47KN); Mamba (Gu and Dao 2023, XNI34DQX); Foundation Models for Biosignals (Gu 2025, 2XWEG7AF)

papers.title: Iris: Climbing to the Search Frontier
papers.authors: Liu, Liu, Wang, Qin, Liang, Chu, Chen, Gu, Chuan (AllSpark Research)
papers.what: Trains 35B-A3B and 397B-A17B search agents by alternating supervised fine-tuning with RL against live search, on questions reverse-constructed from a hyperlink entity graph and filtered to those a reference model fails closed-book, reaching 82.2 to 92.9 across BrowseComp, DeepSearchQA and HLE from a single ReAct pass with no sub-agents, and showing inference-time context management moves scores more than most reported differences between systems.

papers.title: RISE: Recursive Improvement via Self-Extrapolating Policy Distillation
papers.what: Builds a distillation teacher out of the model's own RL trajectory by extrapolating the displacement between the current checkpoint and a trailing anchor, in parameter or logit space, turning one sparse outcome reward into dense per-token targets with no external teacher and no distribution mismatch, and beating both RLVR-only training and on-policy self-distillation on math, STEM, code and multi-turn agentic tasks.
papers.builds_on: DeepSeek-R1 (2025, Z5IWHZAE); Chain-of-Thought (Wei 2023, HBLPTRMY); Rethinking On-Policy Distillation II (2026, 2609.04172)

papers.title: Motion-Omni: End-to-End Joint Speech and Full-Body Motion for Spoken Dialogue
papers.what: Generates dialogue speech and full-body co-speech motion from the same hidden states instead of running a motion model over finished audio, staying within 2 percent of the teacher cascade on motion metrics at 5.4x lower latency and 2.62 percent WER, and showing by ablation that a frozen speech pathway leaves motion misaligned so the alignment lives in the shared representation rather than the decoder.
papers.builds_on: Sensor2Text (Chen 2024, ELYUE3NF); Motion Mamba (2024, J2EZPHK4); HeAR (Baur 2024, 3LA8GNCU)
